goal.request: Evaluate whether the newly assigned chaoskampf_cosmogonic_ordering meaning survives both the audited prompt and one generated image while preserving only visible face and hair appearance cues from the supplied reference.

evidence.claim: The byte-exact requester envelope asks for independent random complex concepts, reference use, image generation, and rendered-pixel testing.
The reference visibly supplies long center-parted dark wavy hair and face-appearance cues only; it supplies no identity or sensitive-trait conclusion.
Candidate-pack v6 generation and composed-prompt audit passed with all five profile evidence fields literal and no optional visual concept selected.
evidence.artifact: composed_prompt_audit.json status pass; effective visual contract 8fefbb5377399267e95292a16a1bfc520b15197000993310be5093dc73567d94

evidence.claim: The 248-word final prompt preserves every core anchor, all five chaoskampf obligation phrases, single-frame actor/action/target/consequence, and the reference-appearance boundary.
The exact built-in runtime prompt, negative bytes, intent-lock hash, and reference bytes passed preflight before generation.
The built-in image tool delivered one native PNG; no retry or fallback occurred.
Champion, primordial adversary, and active weapon contact pass, while defeat transition and defeat-caused cosmic ordering fail under strict thumbnail/native review.
Hair silhouette remains continuous, but the rendered eyes are larger and rounder, the face is shorter, and the lower face and jaw are narrower than the source appearance cues.
evidence.artifact: source-appearance-crop.png and render-face-crop.png; no identity claim

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: The image must read as one tradition-bound champion defeating one primordial sea-chaos adversary, with that same defeat visibly creating a new ordered world in the same frame.

invariants.statement: Champion, adversary, two-handed weapon contact, and localized defeat remain one traceable causal event.
Exactly four straight rivers and newly formed concentric terraces visibly originate from the localized defeat rather than pre-exist as scenery.
Visible face and hair appearance cues remain continuous without asserting identity.

flexible_dimensions: exact camera placement within low medium-wide framing

mismatches.source_state: Four straight rivers and concentric terraces newly emerge from the pinned flood at the defeat point.
mismatches.render_state: More than four irregular waterways and horizontal terraces resemble existing terrain, so causal newness is unclear.

mismatches.source_state: The contacted serpent passes visibly from active resistance into defeat or partition.
mismatches.render_state: The foreground head and coils remain active while a separate-looking raised coil fragments in the background.

mismatches.source_state: Reference appearance has a longer face, narrower eye aperture, and broader lower-face width.
mismatches.render_state: The generated face has larger rounder eyes, shorter face length, and a more tapered jaw.

hypotheses.statement: The generator strongly realized the combat inventory but compressed the exact defeat-to-order topology into generic epic terrain, weakening causal ownership of the channels and terraces.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched, independently permitted render using the same frozen evidence shows exactly four impact-origin rivers and newly formed concentric terraces without changing the prompt semantics.

hypotheses.statement: The distant action framing and fantasy beautification response outweighed the requested source-relative face geometry despite explicit appearance controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched permitted identity-controlled render at comparable face scale retains the source-relative eye aperture, face length, and jaw width while keeping the same action scene.

intervention.general_rule: No reusable skill change is claimed from this one motivating render.
intervention.generalization_basis: The arm records falsifiable generator-response hypotheses and preserves the failed sample for later unrelated holdout testing.

decision.rationale: Structural and prompt layers pass, but strict native-pixel review fails the defeat, order, exact core action/consequence, and visible appearance-continuity requirements; user preference is still unscored.
